title: ROC-AUC
hints: Sort the examples by score. Then count, for each positive, how many negatives sit below it, without ever pairing examples up explicitly.
Handle a run of equal scores as one group: its positives beat every negative below the group and tie with the negatives inside it.
Rank all the scores together, letting tied scores share their average rank. A positive's rank then tells you how many negatives it beats, ties included.
